rules: Hexagonal layering: internal/core never imports adapters; adapters implement ports.

Write the failing test first, then the code. Behaviour that crosses a process boundary gets a black-box test in internal/e2e or frontend/e2e.
Document every exported Go identifier and every TypeScript export; each Vue component starts with a description comment.
A new capability must exist on REST, MCP, CLI, desktop, frontend and extension, or say why not (internal/docscheck).
Update CHANGELOG.md and docs for user-visible changes.
Mutation testing is local only (make mutation); never add it to a workflow.
